scenes.text: Imagine waking up in the middle of July and seeing snow piling up outside your window.
In 1816, the world experienced a literal year without a summer because a massive volcanic eruption blocked out the sun.
To pass the time in a gloomy Swiss villa, a young Mary Shelley and her friends started telling scary stories.
Inspired by the apocalyptic, dark atmosphere outside, she ended up writing 'Frankenstein' out of sheer weather-induced boredom.
